aomAtlanteanRumor0.text: Lava Titans, Sickle Titans and Moss Titans are the most powerful creatures of Atlantis.

aomAtlanteanRumor1.text: I hear the people of Atlantis will dig the Nine-Ring Canal Capital in honor of the hero who brings them the Grail.

aomAtlanteanRumor2.text: Legend has it that Atlantis was once the kingdom of the ten kings in the ocean west of Enroth. Only after the home island sank did the survivors scatter to many shores and rebuild their ring-shaped cities.

aomAtlanteanRumor3.text: They say the Atlanteans stopped worshipping the Olympians long ago. The ones they serve are the three Titans: Kronos, Oranos and Gaia.

aomAtlanteanRumor4.text: Every Atlantean soldier bears one of the three Aspects of Sky, Time and Earth. Whichever Aspect is ascendant in a round, its soldiers are both fast and fierce.

aomAtlanteanRumor5.text: An enemy singled out by a Winged Longbowman is marked with the Sky Eye. However far the shot, even over a wall, arrows hit it at full strength.

aomAtlanteanRumor6.text: Do not let a Sickle Titan cut you three times in a row: each cut slows you a little more, and at three stacks you cannot move at all that round.

aomAtlanteanRumor7.text: Grass and trees spring up wherever a Moss Titan has stood. Wounds slowly close on friends who step there, while enemies get their feet tangled in the roots.

aomAtlanteanRumor8.text: Soldiers standing on lush grass need not fear having their time locked.

aomAtlanteanRumor9.text: An old soldier told me that when an army has all four of Sky, Time, Earth and Mortal, the stack turned hero can strike one more time in a round.

aomAtlanteanRumor10.text: A hero of Atlantis who visits the Patron Temple receives one blessing, according to the patron god he serves.

aomAtlanteanRumor11.text: I hear there are Sky Passages between the towns of Atlantis. A hero takes one step and is in another town.

aomAtlanteanRumor12.text: When Kronos leads the army, Time stays ascendant for two rounds in a row.

aomAtlanteanRumor13.text: For heroes who serve Gaia, the Lush Ground underfoot heals more.
